description: The state plans to expand specialised clinics to 200, introduce CGM devices for 4,000 patients and strengthen school-based screening and long-term disease management.
body_lead: The Government of Rajasthan is implementing Mission Madhuhari , a programme for the diagnosis, treatment, monitoring and long-term management of children and young people with Type 1 Diabetes. According to the Medical and Health Department, an estimated 53,000 people in Rajasthan are living with Type 1 Diabetes. The programme aims to reduce mortality from the disease by 2030 through improved treatment, monitoring, awareness and the use of digital technology.
